task: My manager assigns me tasks at the beginning of every week with a subject starting with "Assignment". At the end of each week, I reply to them "Finished." or "Not Finished.". For this week, I have starred the emails/tasks which I finished working on, and left the others unstarred. I am closing off this week now, please reply accordingly, and unstar those threads. I may have non-todo emails starred, please keep them as is.
